content.title: Open the concentration warning popover
content.intent: Prove the interactive warning reveals the anchored popover with the concentration details and recommended action.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to separate the interactive disclosure path from passive dashboard review. Applied state/flow because the scenario changes from warning-visible to popover-open. No covering array was needed because the source defined a single interaction path rather than multiple independent inputs; risk-judged combinatorial strength remained 2 (no money, auth, or data-loss factors applied to the grounded behavior).

content.title: Dismiss the warning popover by clicking elsewhere
content.intent: Prove the warning popover closes when a pointer interaction occurs outside the warning and its anchored popover.
content.technique_notes: Applied state/flow to the open-to-dismiss transition and equivalence partitioning to keep outside-click dismissal distinct from keyboard dismissal because the source named it as a separate close mechanism. No covering array was needed; risk-judged combinatorial strength remained 2 (no money, auth, or data-loss factors applied to the grounded behavior).

content.title: Dismiss the warning popover with Escape
content.intent: Prove the warning popover closes from the open state when Escape is pressed.
content.technique_notes: Applied a11y because the source explicitly grounded a keyboard-driven dismissal path with Escape, and state/flow because the scenario proves the transition from open popover to closed popover. No covering array was needed; risk-judged combinatorial strength remained 2 (no money, auth, or data-loss factors applied to the grounded behavior).

content.title: Review default portfolio risk status and warning signal
content.intent: Prove the default dashboard view exposes the risk metrics, gauge state, and visible concentration warning before any interaction.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to keep the default read-only dashboard path distinct from the interactive popover path. I judged pagination, boundary, security, perf, i18n, and responsiveness techniques not applicable from the cited source because it described fixed displayed values and warning interaction only. No covering array was needed; risk-judged combinatorial strength remained 2 (no money, auth, or data-loss factors applied to the grounded behavior).

judgements.rationale: [value_score] No budget cut was needed because 4 scenario/test pairs fit under the supplied ceiling of 8. I ordered the set with interactive warning behavior first because it is the actionable feature outcome, then kept the baseline dashboard review as a separate lower-risk read-only path.
